*Overview*  
The women's team archery event was one of four archery competitions at the 2012 Summer Olympics in London. Held at the historic Lord's Cricket Ground from July 27 to July 29, 2012, the event featured 12 three-archer teams (36 athletes total) representing nations from around the world.
